propositions: Git probes (porcelain and head) in repo-isolation hooks run without timeout, allowing pytest to hang indefinitely after test completion when a probe blocks
Unbounded subprocess.run calls in tests/_isolation.py can be reached both from pytest_sessionfinish hook and autouse _no_repo_commits fixture teardown
Ordinary probe failures (OSError, CalledProcessError, non-repo) must return None while TimeoutExpired must surface as explicit infrastructure failure
A fixed 5-second timeout on Git probes bounds local hangs without requiring configuration, with headroom >80x beyond measured baseline (p95 0.0164s)
Module-level subprocess.run binding prevents test-level monkeypatches from contaminating autouse teardown by capturing the real runner at import time

Stable sleep primitive isolation prevents unrelated test monkeypatches (e.g. canary fixture patching time.sleep) from interfering with subprocess internal timeout backoff during bounded probe execution
